identificationModule.briefTitle: Endostar Combine With Radiotherapy in Brain Metastasis of NSCLC
identificationModule.officialTitle: Endostar Combine With Radiotherapy in Brain Metastasis of NSCLC

leadSponsor.name: Union Hospital, Tongji Medical College, Huazhong University of Science and Technology

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Observe the effect os radiotherapy plus or not plus endostar in the treatment of brain metastasis in NSCLC
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: The investigators will observe the time controlled by the brain lesion after the test and the total survival time of the patients. Meanwhile, during each follow-up, the investigators will extract cerebrospinal fluid for genomic analysis of cerebrospinal fluid

armGroups.label: arm a
armGroups.description: This group is a placebo control group, and we will use radiation therapy plus Placebos as the control group for the study

armGroups.label: arm b
armGroups.description: This group belongs to the experimental group. We will use radiotherapy combined with endostar for treatment, so as to judge the efficacy of the medicine

primaryOutcomes.description: the time from the start of treatment to the progression of the brain metastases, in months
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of randomization until the date of first documented progression of brain lesions, and the maximum evaluation time is 36 months

secondaryOutcomes.description: the total survival time of the patient from the start of treatment
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of randomization until the date of death, assessed up to 36 months

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* NSCLC Brain metastasis

Exclusion Criteria:

* KPS\<60
